title: Crackle Check
intro: Crackle Check runs from your own code and agents as well as this page, and the segments it reads are open data you can load yourself, with no account needed for either.

sources.title: Call Crackle Check from code or an agent
sources.license: Code Apache 2.0; readers MIT; scans CC BY-NC 4.0
sources.note: Examples are precomputed; a new region uses ZeroGPU time, so pass Client(..., token=...) to use your own. Model output, not a reading.
